main_text.p: hodiernum auch: airthai prifcis Germanis eft erdu,originis hebraeq,de qua fupra. Hlaif panis Gothis eft idem,quod hodiernis Germanis inferioribus leif vel laif, fuperioribus vero leib,demia afpiratione,fubintellige panis, cin lcib brot: thana articulus: fintenan a fy iaco fun. vel finkanan haud dubie natum, ut intelligatur panis neceffitatis, qui fcilicet quotidie nobis eft neceffarius: in quem certe fenfum Syrus interpres Graecam vocem Matt.6,11.ἐπιούσιον[?] expresse vertit, lachma de funkanan, panem necessitatis a verbo jenak, indigere, opus habere Matth.3,14. Himmadaga compo-situm ex him vel hem, hoc vel ipsum, & daga dies, quod Germani prisci unà voce hiu'u, & hodierni hüt vel heutt exprimunt: aflet, Germanis priscis oblaz, dimitte, a themate aflaten, vel ablaßen: sculam Germanis sculdi vel sculti, noxae, crimina, metonymicè debita pro noxis vel criminibus. unde sculteis, debita pro noxis exigens Eis enim sive eisch & cum aspiratione heisch est postulo, exigo &c. Sic quod Gothis est fua vel fue, Germanis est so vel sofa, sicut, velut: weis Germanis Wir, nos: ni congruit cum th privativa particula Graecâ: briggais, Germanis fi letti, inducas, nobis scriberetur bringe/verleite: fraestubngai Gothicum merum, priscis Germanis korunka, hodiernis versuchung:

page.notes: The marginal note "Matt.6,11." is in the left margin. The Greek word ἐπιούσιον is only partly legible in the scan and is marked [?]. The number in "Matth.3,14" is uncertain. The mark at the foot right is read as the catchword "ak" with [?]; it may be a signature or a stray mark. No page number is printed. The text is one unbroken paragraph from the previous page; the Latin and Gothic forms are copied as printed.
